annotation.title_clean: Framework of Responsible Industry Behaviour for AI in the Military Domain
annotation.title_en: Framework of Responsible Industry Behaviour for AI in the Military Domain
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNIDIR (United Nations Institute for Disarmament Research) in partnership with OHCHR
named_instruments_referenced: UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
annotation.summary_en: UNIDIR programme page, with OHCHR, describing a developing voluntary Framework of Responsible Industry Behaviour for AI in the Military Domain. It aims to give industry a common baseline of principles and practical guidelines, built through multistakeholder co-development and grounded in international law, without binding commitments.
key_provisions_or_claims: Framework will be voluntary principles and practical guidelines for industry in military AI
Grounded in international law and builds on REAIM and UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
Contributors include Microsoft, Hitachi America and Japan Defense Technology Foundation
Participation implies no endorsement or binding commitment
